summary: Phase 3A: Panel Binding UI & Controlled Linking - All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend code review confirms correct implementation of module/panel linking UI, unique field checkbox, and linked badges.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend requires Firebase Auth for testing. Code review confirms all Phase 3A UI elements are implemented correctly with proper data-testid attributes.

✓ Panel creation auto-adds 'Invoice' relation field when allowedModules includes 'invoices'
✓ Panel linking validation: max 2 linked panels enforced
✓ Panel linking validation: no self-linking enforced
✓ Panel linking validation: no circular linking enforced

✓ GET /api/business-tools/panels/linkable-targets returns system modules (inventory, invoices) and custom panels

✓ Frontend has Unique checkbox in field form (data-testid='field-unique-checkbox')

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3A Panel Binding & Controlled Linking fully tested. All backend APIs work correctly: (1) allowedModules and allowedPanels supported in create/update panel, (2) Auto-add Product relation field when linked to inventory, (3) Auto-add Invoice relation field when linked to invoices, (4) Panel linking validation (max 2, no self-link, no circular), (5) Unique field validation at DB level, (6) Activity logging on record creation. Frontend code review confirms all UI elements are implemented with proper data-testid attributes. The app uses Firebase Auth so UI testing requires real credentials.
